verse.verse_1: I swear by the Day of Resurrection.
verse.verse_2: And by oath of the soul that reproaches itself.
verse.verse_3: Does man assume that We will never assemble his bones?
verse.verse_4: Surely yes, why not? We can properly make all his phalanxes.
verse.verse_5: In fact man wishes to commit evil in front of Him!
verse.verse_6: He asks, “When will be the Day of Resurrection?”
verse.verse_7: So when the eyes will be blinded by light.
verse.verse_8: And the moon will be eclipsed.
verse.verse_9: And the sun and the moon will be united.
verse.verse_10: On that day man will cry out, “Where shall I flee?”
verse.verse_12: On that day, the station is only towards your Lord.
verse.verse_13: On that day, man will be informed of all what he sent ahead and left behind.
verse.verse_14: In fact, man himself is keeping an eye on his state of affairs!
verse.verse_15: And even if he presents all the excuses he has, none will be listened to.
verse.verse_16: O dear Prophet (Mohammed – peace and blessings be upon him), do not cause your tongue to move along with the Qur’an in order to learn it faster.
verse.verse_17: Indeed assembling the Qur’an and reading it are upon Us.
verse.verse_18: So when We have read it, you should thereupon follow what is read.
verse.verse_19: Then indeed, to explain its details to you is upon Us.
verse.verse_20: None except you, O disbelievers – you love what you have, the fleeting one.
verse.verse_21: And you have forsaken the Hereafter.
verse.verse_22: On that day, some faces will shine with freshness.
verse.verse_24: And on that day some faces will be ghastly.
verse.verse_25: Knowing that they will be subjected to a torment that breaks the backs.
verse.verse_26: Yes indeed, when the soul will reach up to the throat.
verse.verse_27: And they will say, “Is there any one – any magician?”
verse.verse_28: And he will realise that this is the parting.
verse.verse_29: And one shin will curl up with the other shin.
verse.verse_30: On that day, the herding will be only towards your Lord.
verse.verse_31: Neither did he believe it to be true, nor did he offer the prayer.
verse.verse_32: But he denied and turned away.
verse.verse_33: Then he went back to his home in pride.
verse.verse_34: Your ruin has come close, still closer.
verse.verse_35: Again your ruin has come close, still closer.
verse.verse_36: Does man assume that he will be let loose?
verse.verse_37: Was he not just a drop of the semen that is discharged?
verse.verse_38: He then became a clot – so Allah created him, then made him proper.
verse.verse_39: So created from him a pair, the male and female.
verse.verse_40: So will He, Who has done all this, not be able to revive the dead?
